mentions.name: Harmless
mentions.description: A vibe-coded open-source clone of the classic space game Elite, playable in the browser. Development follows an 'Open Vibe Code' model: contributors file issues which Claude then implements, with pull requests rejected in favor of issue-based contributions. Built as a fun experiment to see what's possible.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a totally vibe coded clone of Elite - https://github.com/atomic14/harmless - so far it's pretty playable.

You can try it out here: https://harmless.atomic14.com

I'm planning on doing it Open Vibe Code. Add an issue and I'll set Claude on it.
mentions.author: iamflimflam1
